test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

New policies are being drafted by the government for immigrants.

options.text: The government drafts new policies for immigrants.
The government is drafting new policies for immigrants.
The government has been drafting new policies for immigrants.
The government drafted new policies for immigrants.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. The government is drafting new policies for immigrants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is written in the **passive voice**: "New policies are being drafted by the government for immigrants."
 
• To convert it into the **active voice**, the subject (the government) must perform the action.
 
• The **correct tense** in the passive sentence is present continuous ("are being drafted"), so the active voice must also use the present continuous tense.
 
• Among the options given:
 
 
• Option 1: "The government drafts new policies for immigrants." - Incorrect as it is in the present simple tense.
 
• Option 2: "The government is drafting new policies for immigrants." - Correct as it is in the present continuous tense and maintains the intended meaning.
 
• Option 3: "The government has been drafting new policies for immigrants." - Incorrect as it changes the tense to present perfect continuous.
 
• Option 4: "The government drafted new policies for immigrants." - Incorrect as it changes the tense to past simple.
 
 

Correct sentence: *The government is drafting new policies for immigrants.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active vs Passive Voice:**

 
 
• In the active voice, the subject performs the action (e.g., "The government is drafting policies").
 
• In the passive voice, the subject receives the action (e.g., "Policies are being drafted by the government").
 
 
 
• **Tense Consistency:** When converting between active and passive voice, the tense of the sentence should remain consistent.
